query: My net trade income in a work year was negative. Can I trade the losses to offset my income in the following year to qualify for the Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) scheme?
reference_answer: Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) is based on your net trade income earned in the work year and does not include previous year's losses.
answer: Based on the information available, you cannot trade losses from one year to offset income in another year to qualify for the Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) scheme. This method of income adjustment is not allowed under the WIS criteria. [Document 1]
